product_metadata.title: Wolf Corp The Den Mattress, Full, White and Black
features: Contains an 8", 580 wrapped Coil innerspring unit that holds its Shape and provides less partner disturbance
Pre-compressed coils surround the perimeter for great edge support
Contains Wolf's cotton/Poly bonded fibber product for support
Covered in geometric fabric with "cool Air" fibbers creating great sleep surface
Quilt Contains convoluted foam for conforming comfort
description: Looking for a quality mattress at very competitive pricing? looking for a mattress manufactured in the USA? look no further. Wolf Corporation has been creating sleep products since 1873 and our "Wolf pack" Series is our latest product line, offering a good, better, and best option. The "den" is the "better" mattress in the Wolf pack Series. This is a great 10" wrapped coil mattress that provides unbelievable comfort. The "den" contains an 8", 580 wrapped coil innerspring unit featuring stress-relieved wire that holds its shape and provides a durable, consistent sleep surface. The wire flexes and conforms to the individual contours of the body for superior comfort and reduced partner disturbance. This wrapped coil unit has pre-compressed coils that surround the perimeter, providing a better edge support than foam reducing or eliminating that roll-off feeling, and delivering a consistent sleep surface. The den also contains some of Wolf's cotton/poly bonded fibber product for additional support. The den is covered in a geometric stretch knit fabric with "cool air" fibbers to keep the sleeping surface cooler. The cover is quilted with convoluted foam to create a medium sleeping surface. Isn't it time that you "quit counting sheep...sleep with a Wolf"?.
